summary: Consolidated the parent account so it carries all four witnessed consequence classes rather than leaving the two compaction ones only in child accounts. The rewritten rationale names the cause once (sync_log adds the carried StopSign on top of sync_idx plus the suffix while the sender's resume point may already count it, and create_log_sync never shifts sync_idx for a StopSign the sender holds) and cites each class with its receipt and decisive events: a replica that already accepted the StopSign ending one index past its content and losing its reconfiguration endpoint and decided-log read (follower after reconnected(), follower re-promising in an ordinary new term, the leader that takes over from such a follower, and two followers under a snapshot-capable entry type); the drift of one index per re-synchronization round across three consecutive rounds; the leader's decision at a drifted index on a write quorum of drifted reports, with the single-reporter counter-case where the leader stayed consistent; and both compaction paths acting on the drifted values, where trim(None) compacted index 7 for a log of six indices of content and snapshot(Some(8), false) was accepted and produced a snapshot holding none of the five decided entries. It keeps the same-run controls (pre-change samples and the no-reconnect control), the counterevidence that bounds each class (control runs; the two-reporter requirement; trim's minimum rule keeping a truthful replica honest; the StopSign equal-case adjustment), the limits (three rounds by construction, no timers or loss triggers, three-node in-memory clusters and one snapshot-capable entry type, the shared-name admission caveat behind several unknown comparison outcomes, and the sealed configuration bounding the effects to accounting, readability and compaction), and a joint_history listing all eight receipts of the lineage including the trim and snapshot ones, plus the child knowledge entries the account relies on. No execution was requested this turn; incomplete are the snapshot variants named in the child's discriminator, the trim child's other-producer question, the drift's bound and reconfiguration-handoff questions, timers and loss triggers, larger clusters, persistence, and any further independent lead.
